messages:
sara: I pushed the postmortem follow-ups doc to the drive: https://redwood.work/drives/incidents/pm-followups. Please read and add owners/timelines by EOD Friday.
ben: thanks sara, skimming now. can we have a compact timeline template? the table in the doc is pretty heavy.
clara: +1 on a lighter timeline. suggest columns: action, owner, due date, status, block. one-line each.
sara: good call. updated the doc with a minimal timeline section and an example row.
devbot: Reminder: weekly followup sync created -> Wednesdays 10:00am (UTC). Join: https://meet.redwood/incident-followups
erin: assigning a few items now:
- root cause remediation: ben -> due 2024-08-09
- alert tuning & runbook updates: clara -> due 2024-07-31
- postmortem comms template -> frank -> due 2024-07-28
frank: noted. I'll draft the comms cadence (initial, 24h update, resolution notice, postmortem link).
ben: thinking about recurring pattern — multiple latency incidents tied to small spikes in batch size. propose adding a recurring incident category and a short mitigation playbook.
clara: can we also rotate incident commander more formally? last 3 weeks same person. propose a 2-week rotation and a public calendar.
sara: agree. added 'IC rotation' as an action item. erin can you own the calendar + automation?
erin: I can. I'll add a team calendar and set automated reminders to the oncall channel. also will set Github issues for each action item so we can track PRs/closure.
frank: can we add a metric to monitor recurring incidents? maybe a weekly report that counts incidents by category and owner.
ben: yep — team metrics in the console already can be filtered. i'll add a dashboard widget and link it in the doc.
clara: about comms cadence, make sure the 24h update is small — one sentence + next steps. Ops gets inundated otherwise.
sara: good note. updated the template example to one-sentence updates.
devbot: Action item assigned: IC-rotation-calendar -> erin (created issue #412) :white_check_mark:
ben: quick Q: who does remediation verification sign-off? we need a clear owner and acceptance criteria.
sara: owner of the action does remediation and then assigns verification to oncall lead for that week (IC). added to doc.
frank: I'll take verification for the runbook updates this cycle.
erin: I've added Zapier reminders for overdue items and a Slack thread summary every Friday.
sara: thanks all. next steps: everyone to update owners/dates by EOD Friday; weekly sync Wednesday 10am; I'll post final doc link in #eng-oncall and pin it. :thumbsup:
